name: rm-toast-notification
description: A lightweight, customizable, and dependency-free toast notification service for web applications. Display timed notifications with auto-dismiss, animations, and multiple styles. Works with React, Angular, Vue, Svelte, and vanilla JavaScript. Zero-config setup, framework-agnostic, and fully typed with TypeScript.

paragraphs: A lightweight, customizable, and secure toast notification library for web applications with auto-dismiss, custom colors, logos, action buttons, and built-in XSS protection.

@codewithrajat/rm-toast-notification is a lightweight, framework-agnostic toast notification library for modern web applications. It provides a zero-config, fully typed TypeScript API that works seamlessly with plain JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Angular, Vue, and Svelte.

Built with security and accessibility as first-class concerns, the library sanitizes all HTML content through DOMPurify, guards against XSS and CSS injection attacks, validates logo URLs and custom colors, and ships an accessible close button with proper ARIA labels.
features: SSR-safe: no crash when the document is unavailable
Pause on hover while the toast is active
